name: When should bathroom trim be installed during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: When should bathroom trim be installed during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom trim, such as baseboards, crown molding, and window/door casings, is typically installed towards the end of a renovation project. This usually occurs after walls are painted, flooring is laid, and fixtures are in place but before final touch-ups. Installing trim at this stage prevents damage during other construction activities and allows for a clean finish against new surfaces. This sequence helps protect the trim and ensures a precise fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom trim is typically installed towards the end of a renovation, after painting and flooring but before final touch-ups.
